content.text:
I found no contractual NS-500 discount for Acme Manufacturing that was in effect on 2022-10-01. The knowledge base has two Acme NS-500 discount terms, and both start after that date:

| Exception | Agreement | Maximum discount | Valid |
|---|---|---|---|
| EXC-ACME-NS500-10 | ACME-SA-2023 | 10% off list | Orders placed 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31 |
| EXC-ACME-NS500-15 | ACME-MFG-2025 (Schedule B) | 15% off list | 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31 (replaces the 10% one from 2025-04-01) |

The earliest record, the 10% exception, was created on 2023-03-12. A search for older Acme agreements or exceptions from 2021–2022 found nothing. Either there was no contractual discount on 2022-10-01, or its document isn't in the knowledge base. Legal or the Deal Desk would need to confirm which.

If you meant a different date, the 10% cap applies to orders from April 2023 through March 2025, and the 15% cap from April 2025 onward.
